title: Chapter 421: Instant Kill Of Diamond Boss
content:
Chapter 421: Instant Kill Of Diamond Boss

In the monster pile, Wang Shuo faced many monsters alone, and he was not afraid at all.

The dark golden armor looked very ordinary, but the Shura Demon Spear in his hand exuded a charming light.

With a casual stab, a monster was stabbed in the head and died on the spot.

Wang Shuo felt an inexplicable airflow accumulating in his body.

This should be anger!

Wang Shuo grinned, and his moves were open and closed. Monsters below the level of generals would die immediately.

His current ordinary attacks have 40,000 damage. As long as they hit, they are basically dead.

This feeling made Wang Shuo passionate. He blocked the attack of the monster army alone.

The leader of the Greedy Wolf saw that there was actually an intermediate general who rushed into the monster pile to fight.

There was a cold light in his eyes, as the saying goes, soldiers against soldiers, generals against generals.

How could this general have no martial ethics at all?

Then, he looked at an intermediate general beside him.

"Little Pig, go and meet him. Don't let the opponent interrupt our offensive rhythm. Although it's just acting, if the opponent alone can hold back our millions of troops, it will make people laugh."

"Yes, commander."

This demon general named Little Pig is a pig, but not an ordinary pig. He shouted and turned into his original body.

His body is more than 20 meters long, with two sharp fangs, 3 meters long, and his body is covered with hair like steel needles.

It can be soft or hard!

His skin is also very hard, and he has trained it to the level of copper skin.

It can be said that if it weren't for the magic weapon, even his defense could not be broken.

He was quite confident in his defense, so he jumped forward and jumped dozens of meters.

He came in front of Wang Shuo.

Wang Shuo was happy. He had accumulated so much Shura's anger and just needed the opportunity to release it.

"Shura Slash."

Wang Shuo aimed at the giant pig and poured all his anger into the Asura Demon-Breaking Spear, without even exerting his internal strength.

Instantly, a colorful spear light that seemed to be able to split the sky and the earth fell from the sky. The huge knife-shaped light, 40 meters long, hit the giant pig with a force of a thousand pounds.

A scene that Wang Shuo had not expected appeared.

The ferocious giant pig was split into two halves like a piece of tofu.

This scene made everyone on the battlefield stop attacking.

Shocked!

Petrified!

All the people or beasts who saw this scene could not believe their eyes.

One of the little demons, who was splashed with blood, shook his head and rubbed his eyes, thinking that he had hallucinations.

The demon beasts naturally knew that their master pig was a diamond boss comparable to the strength of a human intermediate general!

Diamond boss, this is probably a state that they can never reach in their entire lives.

Then, he was killed in seconds.

Countless demon beasts were already scared out of their wits.

He even had the idea of escaping from the battlefield.

Seeing this, Tan Lang was a little confused for a while.

However, this human warrior was indeed only a mid-level warrior!

"Don't retreat!"

He shouted, no longer shrinking, wanting to tear it apart personally.

Wang Shuo consumed all his anger, felt the power of this attack, and had a deep understanding of this move in his heart.

But the disadvantage of this move is also very obvious, and it requires continuous accumulation of anger.

Fortunately, just now, he figured out two more things.

First, you can get anger by killing the enemy. If you don't kill the opponent, you can also get anger by releasing skills, but the efficiency is much lower.

Second, the red pupil state requires anger to be consumed to open, and once it is opened, it will also consume anger.

It seems that the use restrictions of the Shura suit are very obvious.

The most suitable place to play is the battlefield. Only here can you quickly accumulate anger.
